name: soul_solver_step
description: Record a receipted solver fail/succeed/dead_end. Refuses if this session has pending review candidates. Session overlay only.

tool.description: What was invoked (test runner, edit, grep, sub-agent, …)

receipt.description: Test id, command exit, or check id. Required.

agent_id.description: Sub-agent id; parent omits or uses empty

task_id.description: Optional task grouping inside a plan

close_plan.description: Quarantine compact traces for this plan_id, then drop overlay. Not soul_states.
